data_policy: Evaluation only; no raw AIR files included in repository and no AIR training or fine-tuning.
authors: Marco Jeub, Magnus Schaefer and Peter Vary; RWTH Aachen University
reference: A Binaural Room Impulse Response Database for the Evaluation of Dereverberation Algorithms, DSP 2009
input_format: Original MATLAB h_air double arrays and air_info.fs, no fade or deconvolution in this workflow; documented by upstream load_air.m
arrival_annotations: Fixed first substantial arrivals, approximate; evaluate -24/0/+24 samples at48k, no dataset ground truth claimed.
